result.note: The bill is only pending, so I tested the durable fact that critics cited the FATF 2024 review urging a risk-based approach.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, critics of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill pointed to a 2024 review by which international body that had urged a narrower, risk-based approach to regulating NGOs' foreign funding?
options: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
questions.explain: Critics cited the Financial Action Task Force's 2024 review, which urged a narrower, risk-based approach, alongside earlier warnings on the FCRA from United Nations Special Rapporteurs. The bill, which tightens rules on NGOs' foreign funding, was again not tabled on 6 August 2026 amid Opposition protests.
questions.source: Critics also point to the Financial Action Task Force's (FATF) 2024 review, which urged a narrower, risk-based approach, and earlier United Nations (UN) Special Rapporteur warnings on the FCRA.
